highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Finding Nemo(Claw): Networking Issue Allows for LLM Poisoning in OpenClaw and CISA adds Oracle WebLogic bug to its list of exploited vulnerabilities. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Hackers abuse npm mirrors to host phishing redirect pages. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: LACMA data breach last year exposed social security and medical data. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
